propositions: The close landed-work precheck emits ambiguity diagnostics to stderr for unrelated historical commit references with short prefixes that match multiple tickets.

The resolver resolve_ticket_id is called for every candidate reference extracted from every reachable commit message during history scanning, printing ambiguity errors regardless of whether the reference is relevant to the target close.
Adding a quiet=False keyword-only parameter to resolve_ticket_id gates the three stderr ambiguity diagnostics without affecting gate decision semantics.
_referencing_commit_exists passes quiet=True during its history-scan loop to suppress unrelated ambiguity noise while preserving diagnostics for explicit user-supplied ambiguous prefixes.
Valid full-ID commit references are still correctly detected in precheck scanning even when earlier history contains ambiguous short prefixes.
